tools.name: fetch_time_series_daily
tools.description: Fetch daily stock data with OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) information for each trading day.

tools.name: fetch_time_series_weekly
tools.description: Fetch weekly stock data with OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) aggregated by week.

tools.name: fetch_time_series_monthly
tools.description: Fetch monthly stock data with OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) aggregated by month.

tools.name: search_endpoint
tools.description: Searches for stock symbols and company names based on keywords (e.g., 'Tesla', 'Microsoft Corp').

tools.name: fetch_quote
tools.description: Fetches the latest price and trading information for a stock ticker symbol.

tools.name: fetch_news_sentiment
tools.description: Fetch news sentiment analysis data with sentiment scores, relevance scores, and article metadata.

tools.name: fetch_company_overview
tools.description: Fetch comprehensive company overview including business description, financial ratios, market capitalization, dividend information, and key financial metrics.

tools.name: fetch_income_statement
tools.description: Fetch annual and quarterly income statement data including revenue, expenses, net income, EPS, and other profit & loss metrics.

tools.name: fetch_balance_sheet
tools.description: Fetch annual and quarterly balance sheet data including assets, liabilities, shareholders' equity, and other financial position metrics.

tools.name: fetch_cash_flow
tools.description: Fetch annual and quarterly cash flow statement data including operating, investing, and financing cash flows.

tools.name: fetch_earnings
tools.description: Fetch annual and quarterly earnings data including EPS (earnings per share) estimates vs actual results, surprise percentages, and earnings growth trends.

tools.name: fetch_exchange_rate
tools.description: Fetch real-time currency exchange rates between two currencies with bid/ask prices and conversion rates.

tools.name: fetch_sma
tools.description: Fetch Simple Moving Average (SMA) technical indicator time series with customizable time periods.

tools.name: fetch_ema
tools.description: Fetch Exponential Moving Average (EMA) technical indicator time series with greater weight on recent prices.

tools.name: fetch_macd
tools.description: Fetch MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) technical indicator time series with signal line and histogram.

tools.name: fetch_rsi
tools.description: Fetch RSI (Relative Strength Index) momentum oscillator time series ranging from 0 to 100.

tools.name: fetch_bbands
tools.description: Fetch Bollinger Bands technical indicator time series with upper band, lower band, and middle line (SMA).

tools.name: analyze_stock
tools.description:
One-call stock brief. `filed` holds fundamentals from SEC filings (TTM revenue and growth, gross and
operating margin, net income, free cash flow, net debt; for banks net revenue, net interest income,
efficiency ratio, PPNR, provisions, loans, deposits, ROE, ROTCE and tangible book; for broker-deale

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description:
Side-by-side comparison of 2-6 stocks as one table: TTM revenue and growth, pretax margin, net income
growth and diluted EPS growth from SEC filings (each row's window ends on its ttm_to), net debt for
standard layouts, delayed price, day change, distance from the 52-week high and trend, market cap,

tools.name: get_fact
tools.description:
One reported figure from SEC filings, with its citation: filing accession number, form, filing
date, XBRL tag, period and a link to the filing. Restated values are listed. A figure the company
never reported comes back as missing, never estimated. Values are in units as filed (USD, shares,
USD/share

tools.name: financials
tools.description:
A financial statement from SEC filings, newest period first, every value traceable to its filing.
Quarterly figures the company reported only year-to-date are derived (e.g. Q4 = FY - 9M) and marked;
per-share values and share counts can't be derived that way and are null with reason not_derivable.
A

tools.description: Search all 113 data tools, including ones not in the default list.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Run any Finbolt data tool by name, including ones not in the default list.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: financials · Public sink: fetch_earnings, analyze_stock, financials · Destructive: run_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: financials · Public sink: fetch_earnings, analyze_stock, financials · Destructive: run_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

confidence.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
confidence.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: financials · Private data: verify · Public sink: fetch_earnings, analyze_stock, financials · Destructive: run_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: financials · Private data: verify · Public sink: fetch_earnings, analyze_stock, financials · Destructive: run_tool

confidence.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
